notes.text: Decision BLD-4172: dispatch_command must keep its parameter names, so the parameter cmd may not be renamed until the freeze is lifted.
_run_cli reads the command line and then calls dispatch_command with the subcommand.
The freeze lists parameter names only, not behaviour, so the body of dispatch_command can still be refactored.
dispatch_command is long, so changes to it are reviewed in a separate pass.
validate_url lowercases the hostname before it looks it up in the blocklist of cloud metadata hosts, so mixed-case spellings are blocked too.
_ip_is_blocked treats carrier-grade NAT addresses as internal, in addition to the private, reserved, loopback and link-local ranges.
safe_fetch_text only decodes the bytes that safe_fetch returns, replacing bad UTF-8, so it adds no new network path.
_resolve_and_validate resolves a host once and returns the validated address, so a second DNS answer cannot swap in a private address.
_register_merge_driver writes the graph.json union merge driver into git config and .gitattributes.
_register_merge_driver writes the graph.json union merge driver into git config and .gitattributes.
_unregister_merge_driver removes the merge-driver keys from git config and the line from .gitattributes.
_pinned_python returns an empty string when sys.executable is not shell-safe, and the merge driver command then falls back to the plain launcher name.
BLD-4180 freezes dispatch_install_cli: its parameter cmd keeps its name and may not be renamed, whatever the installer refactor needs.
_merge_driver_status reports whether the merge driver is registered, by reading both git config and .gitattributes.
_merge_driver_status reports whether the merge driver is registered, by reading both git config and .gitattributes.
_install_claude_hook adds the graphify PreToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json.
The codex installer, _install_codex_hook, keeps its hook in .codex/hooks.json and not in a settings file.
_is_ignored decides whether a path is excluded under the .graphifyignore patterns.
_load_graphifyignore reads the .graphifyignore files and returns pairs of an anchor directory and a pattern.
_match_anchored_ignore_pattern keeps a star from crossing a slash when a pattern is anchored.
_parse_gitignore_line parses one raw line of a .graphifyignore file following the gitignore specification.
write_json_atomic streams the encoded JSON into the temporary file instead of building one large string first.
write_text_atomic writes UTF-8 text and delegates the swap to _atomic_replace.
_atomic_replace takes a write function, fills a temporary file with it and moves the finished file into place, so a reader never sees half a file.
validate_graph_path resolves the path and verifies that it stays inside the base folder.
validate_extraction checks an extraction JSON dict against the graphify schema.
validate_semantic_fragment returns the validation errors for an untrusted semantic extraction fragment.
load_validated_semantic_fragment rejects oversize files before it parses them.
_get_backend_api_key returns the first configured API key of a backend, or an empty string.
detect_backend returns the name of the backend that has an API key set, or None.
_validate_ollama_base_url warns about an unsafe OLLAMA_BASE_URL and hard-blocks link-local and metadata addresses.
